links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of AI versus expert dermatologist and non-expert on same images
links.effect: AI sensitivity 93.59% and specificity 70.42% for malignant lesions; similar sensitivity and notably higher specificity than expert dermatologist and non-expert.
links.quote: The AI model demonstrated similar sensitivity and notably higher specificity compared to the expert dermatologist and non-expert.

screen.reason: This is a reader study comparing diagnostic accuracy of an AI image classification system against an expert dermatologist and non-expert on a dataset of skin lesion images.
